summary.what_it_does: The site is the home of All Day DevOps, a 24-hour online conference focused on open source development and DevOps practices. The 2024 event is over, but more than 160 sessions can be watched on-demand. Content is organized into five learning tracks: DevOps + DevSecOps, Dependency Management, AI/ML, Modern Infrastructure, and Leading Thru Innovation. The page features keynotes on generative AI, open source malware, and open source software economics, plus a panel discussing the 10th annual State of the Software Supply Chain Report.
